newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha soft with crude, Egypt tender awarded.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha soft with crude, Egypt tender awarded.

text.p: NWE naphtha was weaker in line with softer futures, traders said.
Vitol won 24 Suez cargoes, averaging 30,000 tonnes each, in Egypt's six-month tender, at quotes' fob Med mean +$18.53 fob Med.

Vitol was also heard to have won 12 Alexandria cargoes, averaging 25,000 tonnes each, at +$10.03. Mira won nine at +$8.30, Marc Rich four at +$8.23 and Stinnes six at +$8.10. The tender was awarded on Monday.
June swaps were talked at around $183/$184 a tonne in late business.. -- London newsroom +44 171 542 8167
